title: Read-only inspection of DBC asset files that have no registry row
objective: A read-only inspection reports every file present under the project DBC asset directory that has no matching dbc_assets registry row - the crash window recorded in docs/PROJECT_STATE.md §9, where the asset file is written and the registry row is not committed. Registry state stays authoritative: the inspection deletes nothing, repairs nothing and writes nothing.
scope: The DBC project service / registry read path and its unit tests.
non_goals: Automatic cleanup, deletion or repair of any file - an explicit recorded decision
Any SQLite schema or migration change
Any HTTP endpoint, API contract or runtime capability change
acceptance_criteria: An asset file present with no matching registry row is reported as an orphan together with its project-relative path
A registered asset whose file is missing is reported separately as a missing file, never conflated with an orphan
A clean project reports neither, and the inspection mutates nothing: no row inserted, updated or deleted, and no file written or removed
handoff_requirements: Report the exact command and result for the focused pytest run over tests/unit/dbc
Report the exact command and result for ruff and mypy over runtime and tools
State explicitly that no migration was added and that the inspection is read-only
